summary: Zone-first workflow (tap colour -> Zone dialog -> zone photos -> Scan <zone> cupboards with sticky banner -> zone-tagged areas) tested end to end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (zone/colour upload naming Galley N, Orange shared by Galley photos, Saloon+Orange 400, invalid colour 400, whitespace/alias normalisation, no-zone legacy behaviour, unauth 401, meta same_zone no clash, cross-zone clash 400). Frontend (390px + 1920px): short tap on overview square opens zone-dialog-<slug>; long press (800ms) shows remove x instead; Saloon empty state + 5-item checklist open + camera/gallery buttons; gallery upload of 2 images -> toast '2 photos added to Saloon (Green)', 2 thumbnails, Scan Saloon cupboards button; Galley dialog 2 thumbnails, enlarge/close, checklist collapsed by default with 9 galley items; Scan Galley cupboards -> batch-scan-dialog with orange zone-banner-galley (label GALLEY, collapsed, expands to plan with only Galley square + 2 photos + checklist, collapses again); batch-area-form chip 'Galley' and 'New Galley boat area'; real Magic Scan of one area + Done -> toast and area listed under inventory-colour-group-orange (GALLEY), persisted after reload; zone-picker chips with count (Galley 1), zone dialog shows '1 boat area already in Galley'; add form hidden until More options; top 'Batch Magic Scan' button now toasts 'Pick the zone to scan first' and scrolls to picker. Crew (free user on pro boat): no zone dialog, Cockpit -> toast 'No Cockpit photos yet', Galley -> opens zone-map-dialog photo, no zone-picker. Regression: Magically Place Colours, palette, Zone Map Photos list (names Galley/Galley 2) OK; no horizontal overflow at 390px in zone dialog or batch dialog.

minor.issue: Clash auto-recolour of a non-manual map (update_one on clash) runs BEFORE _read_picture/put_object, so an invalid/too-big/failed upload still silently recolours another zone map. Move _read_picture before the clash handling.
Name numbering uses count of existing zone photos: delete 'Galley' (keep 'Galley 2') then add -> creates a second 'Galley 2'. Use max suffix+1 or first free name.

Clash exemption uses substring `zone.lower() in name.lower()` - e.g. zone 'Aft' or 'Heads' would be allowed to share a colour with a photo named 'Aft cabin'/'Forward heads'. Prefer exact name/zone match.
Real kitchen photo (unsplash kitchen cupboards) returned 'Ready to review · 0 found'. Not part of this feature, but scan quality may be worth a look.

issues: BatchAreaForm auto-opens on top of the batch dialog, so the zone banner (plan/photos/checklist) can't be expanded while naming the first cupboard; the user must Cancel the form first. Consider showing the banner (or a mini photo strip) inside BatchAreaForm, since the chip alone gives colour+zone but not the photos.
Placed squares overlap (Nav station partly hidden behind Heads Aft, Lazarett behind Cockpit/Transom) - hard to tap the right one on phone.
Long area names (e.g. 'TEST_Galley port cupboard') push the trash icon partly off the right edge of the row (pre-existing).
area-count counts folders/boxes (sub-areas inherit zone) as 'boat areas'; may overstate the number.
